subject: Mathematics
title: Walk...Walk... and Walk
subtitle: Zero, and counting up to 9
hero_picture: A rabbit and a spotted deer walking happily on a forest path among smiling flowers and butterflies; a monkey and a squirrel on a tree wearing pink hats.

sections.heading: A bag of hats
text: Minnu rabbit and Kittu deer went for a walk.
They found a bag full of hats.
Squirrel and monkey took some hats too!
sections.caption: The bag of hats
sections.picture: A rabbit and a deer opening a blue bag under a tree and finding many pink hats; a monkey and a squirrel peeping from the branches.

sections.heading: Nothing is zero
text: Nothing left on the tree. Nothing is zero (0).
sections.caption: Mangoes going, going, gone
sections.picture: A mango tree with 5 mangoes; a squirrel, a crow and the wind each taking one, until the tree has no mangoes left; a boy and a girl looking up.

sections.heading: Hats come back
text: Ramunni Uncle had zero hats. He was sad.
The animals gave back the hats.
sections.caption: Ramunni Uncle gets his hats
sections.picture: A sad old hat seller with a yellow turban sitting under a tree with an empty bag; then animals handing back pink hats to him one by one, and he smiles.

sections.heading: At the pond
text: They counted frogs, fish, cranes and ducks.
sections.caption: Counting at the pond
sections.picture: A pond scene for counting: green frogs on lily pads, small fish, white cranes, dragonflies and ducks, all clearly countable.

sections.heading: Unlock the phone
text: To open it, press 1 to 9 in order.
sections.caption: Numbers on the phone
sections.picture: A smiling rabbit holding a mobile phone with a number pad showing 1 to 9 and 0, a deer, a monkey, a squirrel and a parrot around it.

rhyme: Four, five, all gone, you see,
Zero left for you and me!
activity: Put 9 pebbles in a row. Take them away one by one and count down to zero.
talk: What did Minnu and Kittu find?
summary: Zero means nothing; we can count from 0 up to 9 in order.

questions.prompt: What did Minnu and Kittu find in the bag?
questions.explanation: The bag was full of hats.

questions.prompt: The tree had 2 mangoes. One fell. How many are left?
